components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main booking action on dark surfaces.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--gold); color: #100e09; font: 700 12px 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--gold-light); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold-light); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action beside the gold booking button.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.45); color: var(--ivory); font: 700 12px 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .2s, color .2s; } .ds-button-outline:hover { border-color: var(--gold); color: var(--gold-light); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold-light); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Quiet ivory link in the compact desktop navigation row.
components.css: .ds-nav a { color: var(--ivory); font: 400 12px 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--gold-light); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold-light); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: This visual world faithfully reconstructs the supplied barbershop mockup: a luxury dark editorial canvas, compact cinematic desktop composition, warm amber photography, restrained aged gold, and confident condensed headings. It feels considered and tactile, with a clear visual rhythm that lets the imagery and typography carry the experience. The desktop page uses the reference's wide centered frame and same section order. At mobile widths it becomes a compact header and a vertically stacked, single-column reading flow while preserving the identity and content hierarchy. Eyebrows sit directly above their associated headings, as approved in the final design review.
keyCharacteristics: Black and charcoal surfaces with thin, quiet gold borders.
Warm cinematic barber and interior photography, with dark overlays for readable text.
Ivory Oswald headlines paired with DM Sans navigation, body copy, and controls.
Dense, image-led sections on desktop; touch-friendly stacked sections on mobile.

rules.name: The Gold Restraint Rule
rules.body: Keep gold as a focused accent; it should guide attention without becoming a broad background color.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Oswald for display headlines and DM Sans for everything that must read quickly, including body text and controls.

dos: Do preserve the approved mockup's section order and desktop/mobile structure.
Do keep eyebrows directly above their associated headings.
Do use warm amber photography with dark overlays wherever text shares the image.
Do preserve keyboard-visible focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't introduce bright color accents or broad gold-filled surfaces.
Don't change the condensed display and clean sans-serif pairing.
Don't turn visual placeholders or illustrative content into verified business facts; product details remain configurable until confirmed.
